target_customer: B2B companies that want to automate outbound and inbound sales prospecting
problem: Sales teams spend heavy effort on prospect research, outreach and qualification. Artisan sells AI employees, starting with Ava the outbound BDR.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI employee agents
product_category: AI sales agents (AI BDR, SDR, AE)

founders.name: Jaspar Carmichael-Jack
founders.background_notes: Background not found on the opened YC page.

founders.name: Sam Stallings
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists a Samantha Stallings entry; whether it is the same person is not stated.

competitors.name: 11x
competitors.what: AI SDR persona Alice for outbound email and LinkedIn

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents for lead sourcing, personalization and email deliverability; the CEO later admitted early versions had severe hallucinations, so reliability was the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI SDR vendors with similar features, and the sales stack incumbents could add agents; Artisan's differentiation was brand and speed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors and incumbents shipped AI SDR features through 2025; no acquisition found. HubSpot Ventures invested in the Series A.

market_need_then: Outbound sales is labor intensive and generative AI in 2023 to 2024 made automated outreach feasible; the company reports 250 customers and 5M USD ARR by April 2025 (TechCrunch).

branding.domain_note: Uses artisan.co (not .com); rebranded from Artisan AI to Artisan in mid-2024 per a secondary source.

identity.mascot_or_character: Named AI employees Ava, Aaron and Aria
identity.voice_and_tone: Provocative; the 'Stop Hiring Humans' billboard campaign

branding.brand_signature: 'Stop Hiring Humans' billboard campaign in San Francisco from December 2024

rebrands.why: Not stated; reported by a secondary source only

branding.community_and_virality: The billboards drew wide coverage and backlash (CBS, PetaPixel, Windows Central, Creative Bloq); the company later retired the slogan and reportedly spent about 2M USD on the campaign per KRON4.

brand_strength.rationale: A viral controversial campaign gave unusual awareness for an early company, though it also drew criticism and threats and was later retired.

outcome_analysis: Artisan is active and the best funded of this shard, with a 7.3M USD seed in May 2024, a further seed near 11.5M USD in September 2024 and a 25M USD Series A in April 2025 led by Glade Brook Capital. Its provocative billboard campaign produced outsized awareness while the product matured after early hallucination problems. Rivals in AI SDR are numerous, so durability depends on product reliability.
notes: Company homepage fetch was rate-limited. Pre-seed of 2.3M USD in Nov 2023 appears only in a YC page headline list and is not recorded. The September 2024 round is 12M USD in TechCrunch and 11.5M USD elsewhere, so 11.5M is used and flagged. Seed investor lists were not retrieved. Founder prior employers and education were not on the opened sources, so left empty. Competitor sources are 2026 vendor comparison pages, so as-founded traction is unknown. Product Hunt says Ava first launched February 2024.
